§§§§ options API, minified
<template><div class="card"><h2>{{title}}</h2><button @click="add">Add</button></div></template>
<script>export default{data(){return{title:"Chai",n:0}},methods:{add(){this.n++}}}</script>
<style>.card{padding:8px}</style>
§§§§ script setup with TypeScript and scoped SCSS
<script setup lang="ts">
import {ref,computed} from 'vue'
interface Item{id:number;name:string}
const props=defineProps<{items:Item[];title?:string}>()
const emit=defineEmits<{(e:'pick',id:number):void}>()
const q=ref('')
const shown=computed(()=>props.items.filter(i=>i.name.includes(q.value)))
</script>
<template>
<section :class="{active:isActive,'text-danger':hasError}" :style="{color:activeColor,fontSize:size+'px'}">
<input v-model.trim="q" placeholder="Search" @keyup.enter="go($event)">
<ul v-if="shown.length>0&&!loading"><li v-for="(item,i) in shown" :key="item.id" @click="emit('pick',item.id)">{{i+1}}. {{item.name.toUpperCase()}}</li></ul>
<p v-else-if="loading">Loading…</p><p v-else>Nothing for “{{q}}”</p>
</section>
</template>
<style scoped lang="scss">
$gap:8px;
section{padding:$gap;ul{margin:0;li{&:hover{color:red}}}}
</style>
§§§§ directives, slots and components
<template>
  <MyTable :rows="rows" :columns="['a','b']" v-bind="$attrs" v-on="listeners" @row-click="(row,i)=>select(row,i)" #default="{row}">
    <template #header="{column}"><b>{{column.label}}</b></template>
    <template v-slot:cell="slotProps"><span v-html="slotProps.html"></span></template>
    <template #[dynamicSlot]>dynamic</template>
    <MyCell v-for="n in 3" :key="n" :value="row[n]" v-show="n!==2" v-once/>
    <component :is="kind" v-bind:[attr]="value" v-on:[event].prevent="handler"/>
    <keep-alive><router-view/></keep-alive>
  </MyTable>
  <button :disabled="!ok||busy" @click.stop.prevent="count+=1;log(count)">{{ok?'Save':'Fix errors'}}</button>
  <p>{{ price | currency('₹') }} {{ `template ${literal}` }} {{ a ? b : c }} {{ obj?.deep?.value ?? 'none' }}</p>
</template>

  h2 {{ title }}

{"en":{"hello":"Hello"},"hi":{"hello":"नमस्ते"}}

§§§§ comments
<!-- top-level comment -->
<template>
  <!-- in the template -->
  <div><!-- inline --> text <!-- after --></div>
</template>
<script>
// a script comment
export default { /* inline */ name: 'x' } // trailing
</script>
<style>
/* a style comment */
a { color: red } /* after */
</style>
§§§§ long attribute lists that must break
<template>
  <el-dialog v-model="dialogVisible" title="A fairly long dialog title" width="50%" :before-close="handleClose" :close-on-click-modal="false" append-to-body destroy-on-close class="very-long-class-name another-class" @opened="onOpened" @closed="onClosed"><span>Body</span></el-dialog>
</template>
